# Cleanup operation contract inputs

Retained Metapad original-slice manifests, regional frame/observer facts and
runtime premises from `public-cleanup-regions-v3` and composition v115. These
contain proof observer bodies but no application implementation. Unit tests
exercise assembly and invalidation using these already-checked-input excerpts;
the public composition workflow separately imports and validates the real
regional receipts and exact original files. This fixture is not proof authority.
